description:
Builds a design from YOUR art direction: you write the layout as a spec, Paletoo builds it with its own faces, effects and pictures as editable layers, checks it, and returns the preview plus `corrected` (what it changed) so you can iterate.
Design rules (the whole guide with three example specs: describe_catalogue { what: "guide" } or paletoo://guide/compose):
1. One idea, said in `rationale`.
2. Reference first: to replicate one, describe its grid, blocks and type to yourself, then compose that structure with the person's words and pictures — never its words, logos or pictures.
3. Hierarchy: one dominant element (headline or picture), then a sub, then small meta.
4. Scale contrast: the headline 4–7 steps above the meta (step 0); big against small, not medium against medium.
5. Grid: blocks start and end on columns and rows; one margin; shared left edges; bleed only on purpose.
6. Negative space: leave cells empty.
7. 2–3 inks (≤ 4) from a palette you name: paper, ink, one accent; the picture brings the rest.
8. Type as image: a word huge and tight, stacked with \n, cropped by the grid, over or behind the picture.
9. Meta small on the grid (step 0, upper, wide tracking) in the corners or along one edge.
10. Pictures: the person's photo, a product page, stock words or our pack; cutout for an object standing free.
Fastest good start: { starter: id, words: { headline, sub, meta } } (describe_catalogue starters: the owner's twelve best layouts), then vary one thing. A rough spec still builds; `corrected` says what to fix.
Example: {"format":"post","rationale":"Swiss: the word as the image, one red bar","grid":{"columns":6,"rows":8},"palette":{"paper":"#f2f0eb","ink":"#111111","accent":"#e2231a"},"faces":{"display":"Inter Tight"},"blocks":[{"role":"headline","text":"Grid\nSystems","at":{"col":1,"row":1,"cols":6,"rows":4},"step":6,"weight":800,"tracking":-40,"leading":88},{"role":"shape","at":{"col":1,"row":5,"cols":4,"rows":1},"color":"accent"},{"role":"meta","text":"Thu 20 Nov · 19:00","at":{"col":1,"row":8,"cols":3,"rows":1},"case":"upper","tracking":100}]}
Words: the person's own, in their language; never invent facts. Then say the rationale, give the link, and offer one alternative direction in a line.

background.description: color (a palette name or #hex; default paper), gradient { from, to, angle }, effects; e.g. { "effects": ["film grain"] }

effects.description: our effects by name (describe_catalogue effects), or { name, amount 0–100, colors: [dark, light] } for a duotone; e.g. ["duotone", "riso print"]

blocks.description: the layout, one block per element: { role, at, text, face, step or size, weight, tracking, leading, case, align, valign, color, fill (a plate behind the words: sticker, button, caption box), opacity 0.05–1, rotation °, z (higher on top), effects, outline (hollow letters), shape (a shape block’s; round = rounded rectangle), style (a cta’s button), picture, name (the layer’s), inset (px inside its cells: a mat) }

at.description: grid cells { col, row (1-based), cols, rows (spans, default 1), bleed (to the edge where the cell touches the margin) }, or one per format key { post: {…}, banner: {…} }; e.g. { "col": 1, "row": 1, "cols": 6, "rows": 3 }

color.description: a palette name or #hex: the words’ ink or a shape’s fill

effects.description: our effects by name (describe_catalogue effects), or { name, amount 0–100, colors: [dark, light] } for a duotone; e.g. ["duotone", "riso print"]

leading.description: % of the size; e.g. 88 display, 140 text

picture.description: from: person (image_url / file), url (a picture or product page), stock (words; left out when no photo shows them), pack (id: describe_catalogue pictures), starter (id, layer); cutout: an object standing free; shape; focus { x, y } 0–1; e.g. { "from": "stock", "words": "concert crowd" }

size.description: or px at a 1080 short side (snapped to the scale)

step.description: size as a step on the scale: 0 = base; a headline 4–7, a sub 1, meta 0

text.description: the words, in the person’s language; \n for your own line breaks

tracking.description: 1/1000 em; e.g. −40 tight display, 120 small caps

design.description: optional: a design (id or link) to compose INTO instead of a new file — its empty board, else beside its boards

faces.description: two faces by name (describe_catalogue faces; a known face or a kind: «Helvetica», «антиква»); e.g. { "display": "Inter Tight", "text": "Inter" }

file.description: ChatGPT fills it: the photo the person attached, for a picture block { from: "person" }

format.description: post | story | square | poster | banner | youtube | a4, or { w, h } in px; e.g. "post"

formats.description: several formats in one look (a block’s `at` may then be one per format key); e.g. ["post", "banner"]

grid.description: columns (default 6), rows (8), margin (px at a 1080 short side: 70, or a fraction), gutter (22), baseline (8); e.g. { "columns": 6, "rows": 8 }

image_url.description: the person’s own photo (https or a data: URL) for a picture block { from: "person" }

lang.description: the words’ language (faces are checked for its letters)

name.description: the file’s name; e.g. "Jazz night poster"

palette.description: ≤ 4 colours by name that blocks refer to; e.g. { "paper": "#0f0f12", "ink": "#f4f1ea", "accent": "#ff4d2e" }

rationale.description: ONE line: the idea and why it fits the brief (or which reference it follows); e.g. "Swiss: the word as the image, one red bar"

recipe.description: optional: a style recipe’s name (describe_catalogue recipes); its faces, inks and effects fill what the spec leaves out

reference.description: the reference this replicates (its address, or what it is), when there is one

starter.description: a starting spec’s id (describe_catalogue starters): its grid, inks, faces and blocks; anything you give overrides it

type.description: scale: a ratio (1.25–1.618) or major-third, perfect-fourth, perfect-fifth, golden; base: step 0 in px at 1080 (28); e.g. { "scale": "perfect-fifth", "base": 26 }

words.description: with starter: the person’s words by role (headline, sub, meta, number, cta; a string or a list); e.g. { "headline": "Night shift" }

name: compose_design
title: Compose a design
